correctness.rationale: Independently checked the key harmonic lattice lemma. Log-height tiles of width beta h_m and height log(alpha), with node at beta n h_m+i h_m, stay within delta*h_m with delta=beta+log(alpha). Harmonic disk derivative identity gives |grad u|²<=8/(pi R^4)*int_B |u|², radius h_m/4. Disk containment, tile weighted area <=exp(s+1) beta log(alpha) h_m^(s+2), and disc overlap <=3/(beta log(alpha)) produce contraction factor [6144/pi]exp(s+1)(3/2)^s delta². At delta<=exp(-s)/200 this <=0.133 <1 for s>=0. F_f is holomorphic in weighted A_{2p+1}, injective real-L² Cauchy wavelet transform. Separate real and imaginary magnitude channels force Re(F_f²-F_g²)=0 at nodes. Weighted point evaluation gives F_f²-F_g² in A_{4p+2}; its real part is weighted L²(y^(4p)) harmonic, so global zero, then imaginary holomorphic constant vanishes by Bergman integrability. Integral domain factorization forces F_f=±F_g, hence f=±g. Independently evaluated contraction constants and geometry; finite checks are ancillary to universal analytic proof.
